name: cardilearn_study_family_registry_v0_1
purpose: Prevent linked GEO series or shared experimental programs from being treated as independent held-out studies.

wang_olson_neonatal_regeneration.reason: GSE130699 and GSE153480 describe the same neonatal P1/P8 MI-versus-sham experimental program from the Wang/Cui/Tan/Olson group and must not be counted as independent test studies until sample overlap is explicitly resolved.
